posts.title: Cyberleek drops more NSFW Lucia videos, threatens to release 'GTA 6' in full
posts.summary: Cyberleek reportedly shared more alleged GTA 6 footage featuring Lucia and threatened a full-build leak tied to a $30 million memecoin target; unverified.
posts.source_summary:
Reports published on October 12 say the anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek shared additional alleged Grand Theft Auto VI clips focused on Lucia, following an earlier video of roughly 24–25 minutes featuring gameplay and story scenes. Some outlets describe nudity in the footage; TrendPulse is not reproducing the clips.

Cyberleek has also threatened to publish what it claims is a complete playable build of GTA 6, including the full story through the end credits, if an associated $CYBERLEEK memecoin reaches a $30 million market capitalisation. Reports say the leaker has also demanded a physical-disc release and a public apology from publisher Take-Two Interactive.

The full-build claim has not been independently verified, and a threat is not evidence that a complete version will be released. These are claims reported by news outlets, not an official confirmation from Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
